description: This file defines a custom configuration class for BenchmarkDotNet, named 'BenchmarkConfig', which inherits from 'ManualConfig'. It sets up artifacts path, adds an exporter and diagnoser, and configures options for benchmark runs.

classes.name: BenchmarkConfig
classes.description: A custom benchmark configuration class inheriting from ManualConfig, setting up exporters, diagnosers, and options for BenchmarkDotNet.
